title: Full-time National Servicemen Requiring SAF Financial Hardship Assistance after Enlistment
what_it_is: Full-time National Servicemen Requiring SAF Financial Hardship Assistance after Enlistment

sections.label: NSF financial assistance and AWOL cases
sections.summary: About 80% of TFA applications are approved, averaging 120 NSFs, with grants paid within two weeks and additional grants benefiting over 50 NSFs yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: About 80% of the applications are approved and, on average, about 120 NSFs receive the TFA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Sums range from under a hundred to a few thousand dollars each month and for an average of eight months.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The TFA grants were given to most recipients within two weeks of submitting the completed application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: In addition to the TFA, their Commanding Officer (CO) or Department Head can extend quick financial aid in the form of a one-off Contingency Grant of up to $500, or the Welfare Grant for higher amounts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: These schemes benefit more than 50 NSFs each year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, a minority of NSF Absent Without Official Leave (AWOL) offenders convicted in the General Court Martial cited financial hardship as the main reason, or about 28 cases a year, constituting about 14% of all offenders.

sections.label: 2017 AWOL after financial assistance
sections.summary: In 2017, only one case went on to commit an AWOL offence despite receiving financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Of the cases in 2017, for example, only one went on to commit AWOL offence despite receiving financial assistance.

sections.label: SAF continuing help for NSFs
sections.summary: SAF will continue to help these NSFs, with help given throughout the period of service, up to 12 months at any one time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: From the SAF perspective, we will continue to help these NSFs wherever we can and, as I mentioned earlier, once help is given, it is given throughout the period of service, whichever is lesser, for up to 12 months at any one time.
